about.title: About Us
about.subtitle: Your Trusted Partner in HORECA Supply Since 2020
about.intro: In the HORECA industry (Hotels, Restaurants, Cafés), speed and quality are the keys to success. Top Food provides all your kitchen needs with the highest quality and fastest delivery, so you can focus on growing your business without worry.
about.description: From frozen products and sauces to spices and cheese, everything you need is available in one place, with professional supply services that meet the needs of the HORECA sector efficiently and quickly.
about.vision: To be the leading company in kitchen supply for restaurants, cafés, and hotels, by providing high-quality and diverse products, focusing on innovative and fast solutions that meet the needs of our clients from all sectors.
about.partner: We strive to be the trusted partner for every client, providing them with exceptional services and fast delivery at the best prices.
about.mission:
At Top Food, we are committed to providing the best supply services to our clients in the restaurant, café, and hotel sectors since 2020.
We focus on supplying all kitchen needs, including raw materials and various products.
Our goal is to expand our client base by targeting companies and broaden our services through direct sales to restaurants and supermarkets.
We offer substantial credit based on official documents and guarantees, with fast delivery of orders within specific hours or at the latest by the next day.
We ensure to provide various discounts and offers, and we can supply any product the client needs, even if it is outside the available price list, giving us a competitive advantage in the market.
